description: Lesson a7: three I2C devices on one bus (I2C1 PB6/PB7, 100 kHz) — AT24C02 (0x50, no pull-ups), MPU-6050 on a GY-521 (0x68) and BME280 on a GY-BME280 (0x76) whose module pull-ups serve the whole bus; scan every second, set up each device, print its readings; a busy bus (no pull-up) is reported and retried
expect:
72 MHz. I2C1 PB6 (SCL) / PB7 (SDA) AF open drain, 100 kHz; USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'I2C1 multi-device bus, lesson a7 (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA, 100 kHz)
', 10 ms sensor start-up, then once per second: (1) scan 0x08-0x77 with HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady (1 trial, about 115 us per NACKed probe). HAL_BUSY (SDA/SCL never read high: no pull-up on the bus, e.g. the AT24C02 alone, or an unpowered module holding the lines low) prints 'bus busy: SDA/SCL stuck low (no pull-up on the bus?)
' once, resets I2C1 (HAL_I2C_DeInit + HAL_I2C_Init) and scans again a second later, so the bus recovers without a reset once it is fixed. (2) When the set of answering addresses differs from the last one reported: 'scan: 0x50 0x68 0x76 (3 devices)
' (every answering address) and the three devices are set up in turn: AT24C02 8 bytes at 0x20 read, their complement written as one page, ACK polling through the 5 ms write cycle, read back -> 'AT24C02 @0x50: page write 8 B, ready after P polls, read back ok
' (P about 45); MPU-6050 WHO_AM_I then PWR_MGMT_1 = 0 (it powers up asleep), CONFIG 1, SMPLRT_DIV 0 (1 kHz), +-250 dps, +-2 g -> 'MPU-6050 @0x68: WHO_AM_I=0x68, awake
'; BME280 chip id 0x60 and the trimming parameters -> 'BME280 @0x76: id=0x60, calibration read
'. A device without ACK prints '<name> @0x<addr>: no ACK
' ('MPU-6050 @0x68: no ACK (0x69 answers: AD0 is high)
' when 0x69 answers instead); then 'all 3 devices ok
' or '<n> of 3 devices ok
'. (3) Every cycle the working sensors are read (BME280 forced conversion with oversampling x1, status polled every 1 ms; MPU-6050 6-byte accelerometer burst) and printed as 'read: ax=<raw> ay=<raw> az=<raw> | T=<C> C P=<hPa> hPa H=<%> %
' (raw = g x 16384; P and H truncated to 0.01; flat GY-521 and a GY-BME280 at 25 C / 1013.25 hPa / 50 %RH: 'read: ax=0 ay=0 az=16384 | T=25.00 C P=1013.24 hPa H=49.99 %').

circuit: PB6, PB7: AT24C02 (A2-A0, WP to GND) + 4.7k pull-ups to 3V3
MPU-6050 module: not placed on this bench (the three-device bus with the GY-521 and GY-BME280 pull-ups is covered by tests/lessons/advanced.test.ts)
BME280 module: not placed on this bench
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

USART1.match:
^I2C1 multi-device bus, lesson a7 \(PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA, 100 kHz\)
scan: 0x50 \(1 device\)
AT24C02 @0x50: page write 8 B, ready after (?:3[5-9]|4[0-9]|50) polls, read back ok
MPU-6050 @0x68: no ACK
BME280 @0x76: no ACK
1 of 3 devices ok
$
